stories.story_fr: S&P Global a enregistré une croissance du chiffre d’affaires de 8 % en 2025, atteignant 15,336 milliards de dollars.
stories.story_en: S&P Global delivered revenue growth of 8% y/y in 2025, reaching $15.336 billion.
stories.quote: We delivered revenue growth of 8% y/y in 2025.

stories.story_fr: La marge opérationnelle GAAP s’est améliorée d’environ 3 points de pourcentage en 2025.
stories.story_en: GAAP operating margin improved by approximately 3 percentage points y/y in 2025.
stories.quote: GAAP operating margin improved by approximately 3 percentage points y/y

stories.story_fr: L’entreprise a retourné 6,2 milliards de dollars aux actionnaires en 2025, dont 5 milliards en rachats d’actions.
stories.story_en: The company returned $6.2 billion to shareholders in 2025, including $5.0 billion in share repurchases.
stories.quote: The Company returned $6.2 billion to shareholders in 2025, including $1.2 billion in dividends and $5.0 billion in share repurchases.

stories.story_fr: Martina Cheung a pris la fonction de présidente‑directrice générale le 1er novembre 2024, marquant une transition réussie.
stories.story_en: Martina Cheung assumed the role of President and CEO on November 1 2024, marking a successful transition.
stories.quote: I am pleased that S&P Global delivered an outstanding transition, with Martina Cheung assuming the role President and CEO on November 1, 2024.

stories.story_fr: Le revenu Vitalité représentait 11 % du chiffre d’affaires total en 2024.
stories.story_en: Vitality revenue accounted for 11% of total revenue in 2024.
stories.quote: Vitality revenue, which is revenue from new or enhanced products, accounted for 11% of 2024 revenue.
